title: How We Research
metaDescription: The step-by-step process behind every TopProductPick list, review and comparison.
lede: Every recommendation follows the same process, so you can judge how much weight to give it.

p: Each list starts with who it's for: household size, budget range, skill level or space.
We collect manufacturer specifications, manuals and warranty terms, and note which claims come from the manufacturer.
We read independent expert reviews and patterns in owner reports, looking for repeated praise or complaints rather than single anecdotes.
Every product gets strengths and limitations. We label manufacturer claims as such, and we update pages when products change.
